project.limit.models.text: {models, select, gemini {Gemini models} otherModels {Other models} premium {Premium requests} chat {Chat messages} completions {Code completions} other {{models}}}{window, select, weekly {, weekly} other {}}
project.limit.models.note: The name of a plan limit that covers part of a plan (HI-2734), shown where Combwork says "{name} limit": which models or requests it is for (Antigravity's Gemini models, or its other providers' models; Copilot's premium requests, chat messages or code completions; else the provider's own word, {models}), and, for a weekly one, that it is weekly. "Other models" are the models of providers other than Google.

project.limit.scoped.text: {name}{window, select, weekly {, weekly} fiveHour {, 5-hour} hours {, {hours, plural, one {#-hour} other {#-hour}}} other {}}
project.limit.scoped.note: The name of a plan limit the provider names itself (HI-1125: one of Codex's limits other than its own, such as "gpt-5.2-codex-sonic"), shown where Combwork says "{name} limit": its name as the provider gives it ({name}, never translated), and its window: weekly, 5-hour, or another number of hours ({hours}).
